title: Council Lab: think through a decision
narration: Council Lab helps you think through a decision with Codex. You bring the question and the evidence. A Champion builds the case. A Skeptic challenges it. An Elder weighs both and suggests a next step. You move responses between fresh chats; the lab checks and saves the record. The final call stays with you.
next_step_excerpt: check prospective users' preferred times and access needs, inspect room suitability
